purpose: Exercise and regression-test the deterministic lexical retrieval and answerability-decision pipeline only. All examples and labels were authored as synthetic fixtures; they are not human-annotated, literature-derived, or validated evidence.
limitations: Do not use scores as evidence of real-paper retrieval or answer quality.
Question wording reuses synthetic document vocabulary and can make lexical matching artificially easy.
No language model generates answers; answerability is a thresholded lexical retrieval decision.
Labels are fixture expectations, not a gold standard; this dataset cannot support quality claims.

documents.title: Thermal conductivity
documents.text: The synthetic thermal conductivity experiment measured a conductivity of 4.2 watts per meter kelvin at 300 kelvin using a copper alloy sample.

documents.title: Battery cycle life
documents.text: The synthetic battery cycle life study recorded 820 charge cycles before capacity reached 80 percent under a 25 degree Celsius protocol.

documents.title: Graph benchmark
documents.text: The synthetic graph benchmark evaluated 16 layers and reported a median inference latency of 38 milliseconds on the fixed test device.

documents.title: Membrane filtration
documents.text: The synthetic membrane filtration trial used a pore diameter of 0.20 micrometers and measured a water flux of 14 liters per square meter hour.

documents.title: Solar conversion
documents.text: The synthetic solar conversion fixture reported a peak efficiency of 21.4 percent under an irradiance of 1000 watts per square meter.

documents.title: Language model quantization
documents.text: The synthetic quantization comparison used 4 bit weights and measured a model size of 3.1 gigabytes after conversion.

documents.title: Fermentation yield
documents.text: The synthetic fermentation run lasted 48 hours and produced a yield of 7.6 grams per liter in the controlled vessel.

documents.title: Robotic grasping
documents.text: The synthetic robotic grasping benchmark tested 240 attempts and achieved a success rate of 91 percent on the fixed object set.

documents.title: Network routing
documents.text: The synthetic network routing experiment used 12 nodes and observed a median packet delay of 6 milliseconds.

documents.title: Drug release
documents.text: The synthetic drug release fixture measured 65 percent release after 8 hours in the buffered solution.

documents.title: Crop irrigation
documents.text: The synthetic crop irrigation trial applied 18 millimeters of water per week and recorded a yield of 5.3 tonnes per hectare.

documents.title: Image segmentation
documents.text: The synthetic image segmentation fixture contained 1200 images and measured a Dice score of 0.87 on the held-out split.
